questions.prompt: How many sides does a triangle have?
questions.explanation: Tri means three. A triangle has 3 straight sides and 3 corners.

questions.prompt: How many sides does a square have?
questions.explanation: A square has 4 equal sides and 4 right-angle corners.

questions.prompt: How many sides does a pentagon have?
questions.explanation: Penta means five. A pentagon has 5 sides.

questions.prompt: How many sides does a hexagon have?
questions.explanation: Hex means six. Honeycomb cells are hexagons with 6 sides.

questions.prompt: How many sides does an octagon have?
questions.explanation: Octo means eight, like an octopus with 8 arms. A stop sign is an octagon.
A circle is one curved line, so it has no straight sides and no corners.

questions.prompt: Which shape has 4 sides, with opposite sides the same length?
questions.explanation: A rectangle has 4 sides; the two long sides match and the two short sides match.

questions.prompt: How many corners does a rectangle have?
questions.explanation: A rectangle has 4 corners, one where each pair of sides meets.

questions.prompt: How many faces does a cube have?
questions.explanation: A cube is like a dice: top, bottom, front, back, left and right make 6 faces.

questions.prompt: Which 3D shape is shaped like a ball?
questions.explanation: A sphere is perfectly round in every direction, like a ball.

questions.prompt: Which 3D shape is shaped like an ice-cream cone?
questions.explanation: A cone has a circle at one end and a point at the other.
